create_sparse_pca_fit_transform: create a SparsePCA model and fit_transform data with configurable alpha and method parameters
create_minibatch_sparse_pca: create a MiniBatchSparsePCA model for memory-efficient sparse PCA decomposition
test_sparse_pca_correct_shapes: test that SparsePCA produces correct output shapes for undercomplete and overcomplete decomposition

test_sparse_pca_inverse_transform: test that SparsePCA inverse_transform reconstructs input data with minimal loss
